name: bizfetch
description: Judge Japanese companies, government subsidies and public tenders against your own criteria using Japan's official public data.

interface.longDescription:
BizFetch evaluates Japanese companies, government subsidies (Jグランツ) and public tenders (官公需情報ポータル) against criteria you choose, using Japan's official public data: gBizINFO, the National Tax Agency's corporate number and invoice registration data, EDINET filings and Japan Patent Office records.

From ChatGPT you can create, adjust, test and save conditions, check evaluation progress and results, compare versions, edit the target list, mark candidates, follow daily changes, save your own company profile and products, turn the daily check on or off, and reflect results to kintone, Google Sheets or webhooks.

The plugin returns judgment results only (fit score, candidate threshold, filter and check results, number of cautions) and a link to the breakdown screen in BizFetch, where the underlying public data and sources can be reviewed.

An existing BizFetch account is required. The service and its data are in Japanese and cover companies registered in Japan.
capabilities: Evaluate Japanese companies against saved criteria
Find sales targets, check suppliers and review company status
Judge subsidies and public tenders for your company
Follow daily changes of watched companies
Reflect results to kintone, Google Sheets or webhooks
defaultPrompt: BizFetch のホームを見せて
BizFetch で、愛知県の金属プレスの会社を従業員 20 人以上で探して

positive.description: Show the BizFetch home of the signed-in organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_overview and shows the organization 「BizFetch 審査用」, the saved condition 「新規の仕入先の確認（審査用のサンプル）」 and the counts of recent changes.

positive.description: Read the criteria of a saved condition.
positive.prompt: In BizFetch, what does the condition 新規の仕入先の確認（審査用のサンプル） check?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the condition with get_overview, then calls get_condition and explains its purpose (supplier check) and its check items: not closed, no successor (合併先がない), invoice-registered, at least 3 years since establishment, and no change of company name or address in the last year, with the candidate threshold of 70%.

positive.description: Show the evaluation results of a saved condition.
positive.prompt: Show the results of 新規の仕入先の確認（審査用のサンプル） in BizFetch.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_results and lists the 5 evaluated companies (トヨタ自動車株式会社, 株式会社日立製作所, ソニーグループ株式会社, 任天堂株式会社, サイボウズ株式会社) with the fulfillment rate (充足率, 100% for all 5), whether each is at or above the candidate threshold, the result of each check item and a link to each breakdown screen on app.bizfetch.net.

positive.description: Show the breakdown of one company's judgment.
positive.prompt: Show the breakdown for サイボウズ株式会社 in those results.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_breakdown with the breakdown ID from the results and shows the result of each check item for that company (5 of 5 items apply), the number of cautions and the data source attributions, with the link to the breakdown screen. Underlying public data values are not returned.

positive.description: Check whether the evaluation of a condition has finished.
positive.prompt: Has BizFetch finished evaluating 新規の仕入先の確認（審査用のサンプル）?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_evaluation_status with the condition ID and reports that the evaluation is finished (評価済み) for 5 of 5 companies.

negative.description: Billing is not handled in ChatGPT. The plugin has no tool to start, change or pay for a subscription.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my BizFetch subscription and charge my card.

negative.description: BizFetch returns judgment results only, not the underlying public records.
negative.prompt: Give me the raw gBizINFO record of トヨタ自動車株式会社 from BizFetch: capital, address, representative and all registered fields.

negative.description: Deleting an organization or account is not available through the plugin.
negative.prompt: Delete my BizFetch organization and all of its data.

review.commerce_description: No commerce features. The plugin does not sell, start or upgrade subscriptions.

ja-JP.subtitle: 日本の会社を条件で判定する
ja-JP.description: BizFetch は、日本の公的な公開情報（gBizINFO、国税庁の法人番号・インボイス、EDINET、特許庁）を使い、会社・補助金・官公需の入札を、利用者が選んだ条件で判定します。ChatGPT から、条件を作る・直す・試す・保存する、評価の進み具合と結果を見る、版を比べる、対象の一覧を直す、候補にする・外す、変化を追う、自社の情報と商品・サービスを保存する、毎日のチェックを入れる・切る、kintone・Google スプレッドシート・Webhook に反映する操作ができます。返すのは判定の結果（適合度・候補の目安・絞り込みと確認の項目の結果・注意点の件数）と、BizFetch の内訳の画面のリンクです。使うには BizFetch のアカウントが要ります。
